drop: Drop files here or choose files
limits: Up to 100 files, 100 MiB total input/output and 1,000 pages. Images: 40 megapixels per file, 120 megapixels total. Processing stays on this device. Single-document operations require exactly one PDF.
split: Split each page into a ZIP
rangeHelp: Use 1-3,5. Reorder requires every page exactly once, in the desired order, e.g. 3,1,2. Page numbers start at 1; duplicate, reversed and out-of-range values are rejected.
preservation: A new PDF is created. Form interactivity, bookmarks, attachments, document metadata and digital signatures may not be preserved. Encrypted PDFs are unsupported. This tool lists page order; it does not render PDF pages.
rangeError: Invalid page selection. Use ranges such as 1-3,5, without duplicates, reversed ranges or numbers outside the document.
completeOrder: Reordering requires every page exactly once.
singleFile: Choose exactly one PDF for this operation.
empty: Deleting every page would create an empty PDF.
encrypted: Encrypted PDFs are unsupported. Provide an unencrypted copy.
invalid: The PDF cannot be read or is damaged.
limit: Limit exceeded: 100 files, 100 MiB total input/output, 1,000 pages, or image dimensions (16,384 px per side, 40 megapixels per image / 120 megapixels total).
imageDecode: This browser cannot decode the image. Use a static JPG or PNG.
failed: PDF processing failed. Check the selected files or use smaller inputs.
fileType: Choose PDF files for PDF operations, or static JPG, PNG and WebP for Images to PDF.
name: Merge and split PDFs
description: Combine PDF files, keep only selected pages, split a PDF into separate pages, or turn photos into a PDF. Choose a task and add your files.
